description: What the harness's deploy stage maps over the acceptance corpus's compiled package (Platform ADR 0008): Deploy's shipped presets by name, and document templates by repository path (a file or a directory). Adding one is an edit here, never to harness/stages.py. Each declaration must map at least one record, and each kind under at_least must reach its count (structured_record: event-table rows), or the stage is red. sources declares the civil zone a preset reads a zone-less source in, and require_assertion_scopes makes every stated same-event assertion's scope an identifier the mapped package declares (Platform ADR 0009).
